description: DEVOS-009 + DEVOS-010: Splash screen with animated logo and SplashViewModel, plus 4-page Onboarding HorizontalPager with OnboardingViewModel. Both in feature/feature-auth/. Depends on FEAT-001 (design system components) and FEAT-002 (nav graph placeholder). Independent of FEAT-004 (auth/login).
steps: 1. Create feature/feature-auth/build.gradle.kts if not already created by FEAT-001 (FEAT-001 creates a stub; this step promotes it to full deps). Full deps: plugins hilt+ksp+compose; deps: designsystem, core-common, core-security, core-ui, hilt, hilt-navigation-compose, hilt-compiler(ksp), compose-bom, bundles.compose, navigation-compose, lifecycle-compose, lifecycle-vm, datastore, androidx-browser. Also include test deps: bundles.test-unit, junit5 engine, turbine, mockk, coroutines-test.

2. Create feature/feature-auth/src/main/kotlin/com/devos/ai/feature/auth/model/OAuthProvider.kt. Enum: GITHUB(prefKey='github_token', displayName='GitHub'), GITLAB(prefKey='gitlab_token', displayName='GitLab').

3. Create feature/feature-auth/src/main/kotlin/com/devos/ai/feature/auth/splash/SplashUiState.kt (sealed interface: Loading, NavigateToOnboarding, NavigateToHome) and SplashNavEvent.kt (sealed class: ToOnboarding, ToHome, ToLogin).

4. Create feature/feature-auth/src/main/kotlin/com/devos/ai/feature/auth/splash/SplashViewModel.kt. @HiltViewModel. Injects CheckAuthStateUseCase (stub it via interface if not implemented yet). On init, launches coroutine: delay(1500), then emits nav event. _navEvent: MutableSharedFlow<SplashNavEvent>, navEvent: SharedFlow. _uiState: MutableStateFlow<SplashUiState>(Loading), uiState: StateFlow.

5. Create CheckAuthStateUseCase stub at feature/feature-auth/src/main/kotlin/com/devos/ai/feature/auth/usecase/CheckAuthStateUseCase.kt. Inject DataStore<Preferences> and SecureTokenRepository. Return AuthCheckResult(onboardingComplete: Boolean, isAuthenticated: Boolean). Use runCatching to return a safe default (false, false) if dependencies not wired yet.

6. Create feature/feature-auth/src/main/kotlin/com/devos/ai/feature/auth/splash/SplashScreen.kt. Stateless composable taking uiState and a lambda for nav event collection. Layout: Box fillMaxSize background=colorScheme.background, centered Column with animated scale+fade (animateFloatAsState tween 600ms). Image of ic_devos_logo size 96dp. Spacer base. Text tagline 'Understand your code. Learn faster. Build smarter.' bodyLarge onSurfaceVariant centered. LaunchedEffect(Unit) { delay(100); visible = true }. Collect navEvent SharedFlow.
7. Create feature/feature-auth/src/main/kotlin/com/devos/ai/feature/auth/onboarding/OnboardingPage.kt data class (icon: ImageVector, title: String, description: String).
8. Create OnboardingUiState.kt (sealed interface: Loading, Success(pages, currentPage)).

10. Create feature/feature-auth/src/main/kotlin/com/devos/ai/feature/auth/onboarding/OnboardingViewModel.kt. @HiltViewModel. val pages = listOf(4 OnboardingPage entries per kiro-prompt spec: FolderOpen/Repository Intelligence, Code/Code Intelligence, SmartToy/AI Platform, School/Learn While You Build). _currentPage MutableStateFlow(0). fun nextPage(), previousPage(), skipOnboarding(), completeOnboarding(). skipOnboarding/completeOnboarding: save DataStore onboarding_complete=true, emit ToLogin nav event.

11. Create feature/feature-auth/src/main/kotlin/com/devos/ai/feature/auth/onboarding/OnboardingScreen.kt. Scaffold with top Skip button (Row fillMaxWidth End) and bottom column (step dots + Next/Get Started DevOSButton). HorizontalPager(state=pagerState) for page content. Each page: Column centered with Icon 80dp, Spacer xl, Text title titleLarge, Spacer sm, Text description bodyMedium onSurfaceVariant centered. StepDot composable: Box 8dp circle primary if active else outline. LaunchedEffect(pagerState.currentPage) { viewModel.setPage(pagerState.currentPage) }.

12. Create feature/feature-auth/src/main/kotlin/com/devos/ai/feature/auth/navigation/AuthNavigation.kt. NavGraphBuilder extension functions: fun NavGraphBuilder.splashNavigation(navController) with composable(DevOSRoutes.SPLASH) { SplashScreen(...) navigating to onboarding/home. fun NavGraphBuilder.onboardingNavigation(navController) with composable(DevOSRoutes.ONBOARDING) { OnboardingScreen(...) navigating to login.

13. Update app/src/main/kotlin/com/devos/ai/navigation/DevOSNavGraph.kt: replace PlaceholderScreen for SPLASH with splashNavigation(navController) call. Replace PlaceholderScreen for ONBOARDING with onboardingNavigation(navController) call. Add import for AuthNavigation.

14. Create feature/feature-auth/src/main/kotlin/com/devos/ai/feature/auth/di/AuthModule.kt. @Module @InstallIn(SingletonComponent). Provide DataStore<Preferences> via PreferencesDataStore. Bind SecureTokenRepository to SecureTokenRepositoryImpl once available (use interface stub for now).

15. Write unit tests: feature/feature-auth/src/test/kotlin/com/devos/ai/feature/auth/SplashViewModelTest.kt — test: authenticated→NavigateToHome event emitted; first-launch-unauthenticated→NavigateToOnboarding; returning-unauthenticated→NavigateToLogin. Use UnconfinedTestDispatcher. Mock CheckAuthStateUseCase with MockK.

16. Write unit tests: OnboardingViewModelTest.kt — test: nextPage increments currentPage; skip emits ToLogin nav event; completeOnboarding on last page emits ToLogin; DataStore flag is set true on complete. Use turbine for flow assertions.
18. Run ./gradlew assembleDebug — fix any integration issues.
acceptance_criteria: ./gradlew :feature:feature-auth:testDebugUnitTest exits 0 with SplashViewModelTest and OnboardingViewModelTest passing
SplashScreen has animated logo (graphicsLayer scale + alpha animateFloatAsState)
Tagline 'Understand your code. Learn faster. Build smarter.' present in SplashScreen
OnboardingScreen has HorizontalPager with exactly 4 pages
OnboardingScreen has step indicator dots (StepDot composable)
Skip button navigates directly to LOGIN route
Get Started button on last page navigates to LOGIN route
OnboardingViewModel sets DataStore onboarding_complete=true on skip or complete
SplashViewModel minimum delay of 1500ms before navigation fires
findings: Implemented all 18 steps. Added junit-platform-launcher to libs.versions.toml as testRuntimeOnly dep (was missing from original version catalog). Added testOptions { unitTests.all { it.useJUnitPlatform() } } and lifecycle-vm dep to build.gradle.kts. SplashNavEvent uses data object subclasses for structural equality in tests. DataStore provided via PreferencesDataStore delegate in AuthModule. ic_devos_logo.xml copied from :app to :feature-auth resources. All 11 unit tests pass (8 OnboardingViewModelTest + 3 SplashViewModelTest). assembleDebug BUILD SUCCESSFUL.
